propositions: Production rich-emission state mutation currently routes through all_bindings() query and direct entry mutation instead of using the narrow BindingStore.note_rich_emit facade accessor.
The call site docstring falsely claims binding_store.py cannot carry a narrower accessor, when S2 T3 added exactly such an accessor and the module is no longer at capacity.
No production code path should mutate bindings via all_bindings(); legitimate readers must go through named facade methods.
ADR 0099 lacks finalized recovery boundary, reversal rules, invocation site specifics, and explicit-unretire behavior documentation.
The cutover must preserve hashes, counters, logs, missing-binding fail-open behavior, file bytes, and selective publication without changing output or tickets publication.
